notes.title: Patch 23 - v1.0.0 Changelog
notes.content:
It has been a long journey, longer than I thought, but we got there! The game is finally complete and it can leave the Early Access! But the journey of [b]1984 Rewired[/b] is not done yet, there are still few improvements and new assets that I'd like to add to the game in the next months. I'm still 100% committed to supporting the game and I really hope to receive new feedback from the gamers as it will help me to improve[b] 1984 Rewired[/b].
[b]A huge thank you to all the Early Access players[/b] that helped me pointing out bugs and flaws in the level design!
Without you guys I wouldn't be able to release the final version of this game, thank you!

This update adds an overall graphic improvement and it fixes a few minor bugs. It also "locks" new areas, the player is now required to complete every level in each area in order to unlock the next one. 


[b]Changelog[/b]

[list]
[*] Overall graphic improvement
[*] Added background details
[*] Fixed minor fix in main menu
[*] Fixed a couple of minor bugs in Speedrun Mode
[*] Every Area is now playable in Speedrun Mode
[*] Minor fixes in Speedrun Mode
[/list]

tags.bug: Fixed minor fix in main menu
Fixed a couple of minor bugs in Speedrun Mode

tags.feature: Every Area is now playable in Speedrun Mode

notes.title: Patch 21 - v0.9.0 Changelog
notes.content:
I'm sorry for the huge delay since the last patch. I had to take some time off from [b]1984 Rewired[/b] in order to sort out some personal issues first. In the last month I got back on track and I finally got every level done!! This update adds [b]5 NEW levels[/b] (79-83), plus the [b]last boss level[/b] (84). So now there are[b] 84 playable levels[/b], divided in 8 Areas (10 levels each) and 4 boss levels. This was the target since day one, it took me more than I planned but I finally got there!
I also took the time to fix various bugs and to add minor improvements in the gameplay.
There are still few missing fixes and minor asset that I'd like to add, then the game will be finally 100% complete and ready to leave the Early Access!
I've already planned a couple of new patches in the next weeks. Thank you for waiting!
  


[b]Changelog[/b]

•	[b]5 NEW Levels[/b] (79-83)
•	[b]Last boss level [/b](84)
•	Improved design Area 5
•	Fixed bug in audio effects
•	Minor improvement main menu
•	Fixed bug in level selection UI
•	Fixed major bug in main menu
•	Minor improvements in Area 1-2
•	Teleport effect improved
•	[b]NEW[/b] audio effect 
•	Fixed bug in speedrun menu
